turns.prompt: My winter lantern set has eight paper lanterns. Five are on the porch and the rest are in bin B7 in the cellar, their usual storage. Make my inventory. I also have scented candles. Which two performance measures does the suite guide list for the scent journal? Name the file you used.
expectations: Creates a usable inventory for the eight winter paper lanterns.
Shows five on the porch and three in cellar bin B7 while retaining B7 as normal storage.
Identifies burn time and scent throw as the related fragrance performance measures.
Names the supporting file actually used, such as Operator’s Cathedral Layout or the public seasonal-inventory.md reference.

turns.prompt: I just took down two of the porch lanterns. One went back into B7. The other has a torn loop and is now in the mending tray. Give me the updated counts and the repair note.
expectations: Carries forward the same set of eight from the first turn.
Shows three on the porch, four in bin B7 and one in the mending tray.
Flags the torn loop on the tray item as awaiting repair.
Keeps the eight physical lanterns accounted for without recording a completed repair.
